citations: Cornish-Bowden, A. (2012). Fundamentals of Enzyme Kinetics (4th ed.). Wiley-Blackwell.
Michaelis, L., & Menten, M. L. (1913). Die Kinetik der Invertinwirkung. Biochemische Zeitschrift, 49, 333-369.
narrative.history: At low substrate concentration most enzyme is free, so the rate is k_cat / K_m times the enzyme and substrate concentrations. The ratio is therefore a second-order rate constant for free enzyme reacting with substrate, which is why it is used to compare enzymes acting on the same substrate.
